vessels.name: Large Bowl
vessels.reuse: Dry mix → dough → freed after transfer to counter

vessels.name: Microwave-Safe Bowl
vessels.reuse: Melt all butter at start, portion throughout

states.title: Make Filling Mixture
states.direction: In small bowl, combine brown sugar, 14g melted butter, 50g granulated sugar, cinnamon, cloves, and 0.75g salt. Mix until uniform. Set aside.
states.exit_condition: Mixture is evenly combined with no dry pockets

states.title: Combine Dry Ingredients
states.direction: In large bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, and 4.5g salt.
states.exit_condition: Dry ingredients evenly distributed, no clumps

states.title: Activate Yeast
states.direction: In medium bowl, whisk together warm milk (43°C/110°F), yeast, 28g melted butter, and 25g granulated sugar until yeast dissolves.
states.exit_condition: Yeast fully dissolved, no granules visible

notes.text: Milk must be 40-46°C (105-115°F). Too hot kills yeast, too cool won't activate.

states.title: Combine Wet and Dry
states.direction: Pour wet mixture into dry ingredients. Stir with rubber spatula until dough comes together.
states.exit_condition: Shaggy dough formed, no dry flour visible. Dough will be sticky.

states.title: Knead Dough
states.direction: Transfer dough to lightly floured counter. Knead until smooth, round ball forms.
states.exit_condition: Dough is smooth, slightly tacky but not sticky, holds ball shape

notes.text: Add flour sparingly—too much makes dense buns

states.title: Roll and Apply Filling
states.direction: Roll dough into 30×23 cm rectangle with long side facing you. Brush with 28g melted butter, leaving 1cm border. Sprinkle filling mixture evenly, leaving 2cm border at top edge. Press filling lightly to adhere.
states.exit_condition: Filling evenly distributed and pressed into butter

states.title: Roll Into Cylinder
states.direction: Starting from long edge nearest you, roll dough away into tight cylinder, tucking as you go. Pinch seam and ends closed. Adjust to 30cm length with even diameter.
states.exit_condition: Tight, even cylinder with sealed seam on bottom

notes.text: Keep roll taut—loose rolls cause gaps in finished buns

states.title: Cut and Arrange
states.direction: Grease skillet with 14g butter. Using serrated knife, cut cylinder into 8 equal pieces (~4cm each). Arrange cut-side down in skillet: 1 in center, 7 around edge. Cover loosely with plastic wrap.
states.exit_condition: 8 buns arranged in skillet, covered with plastic

states.title: Rise
states.direction: Let buns rise at room temperature, covered.
states.exit_condition: Buns have expanded and are touching each other

notes.text: Start preheating oven 15 minutes into rise

states.title: Prep for Oven
states.direction: Preheat oven to 175°C (350°F) with rack in middle position. Remove plastic wrap. Brush bun tops with 28g melted butter.
states.exit_condition: Oven preheated, buns brushed, plastic removed

states.title: Bake
states.direction: Transfer skillet to oven. Bake, rotating skillet halfway through.
states.exit_condition: Buns are deep golden brown, filling is bubbling

notes.text: Skillet handle will be extremely hot—use potholders!
Rotate at 13-14 minute mark for even browning

states.title: Cool
states.direction: Transfer skillet to wire rack. Let cool.
states.exit_condition: Buns are warm but not molten-hot

notes.text: Filling is molten—eating too soon will burn mouth

states.title: Make Glaze
states.direction: In medium bowl (V3, now empty), whisk cream cheese, confectioners' sugar, 28g melted butter, 30g milk, vanilla, and 0.75g salt until smooth.
states.exit_condition: Smooth, pourable glaze with no lumps

notes.text: Can make during COOL step to save time

states.title: Glaze Buns
states.direction: Spread glaze evenly over warm buns. Serve immediately.
